review.en: Herodotus set out to explain why Greeks and Persians went to war, and on the way he asked about everything: Egyptian embalming, Scythian burials, the rise of Lydia and Persia. He reports what he was told, often says when he doubts it, and gives non-Greeks their due. The digressions are the method, not a lapse. The word for his inquiry became the name of the whole subject.
review.zh: 希罗多德要解释希腊与波斯为何开战，一路却什么都问：埃及的防腐、斯基泰的葬俗、吕底亚与波斯的兴起。听来的就照录，存疑处常常直说，对异族也肯给公道。枝蔓正是他的方法。他称这部书为“探究”，这个词后来成了整门学问的名字。
